usage.how_to_use: Append the selected copy_paste_suffix_en to the end of the main video prompt.
usage.global_negative_prompt: No overprocessed HDR, no oversaturated orange-teal, no waxy skin, no plastic beauty filter, no crushed unreadable blacks, no blown skin highlights, no random logos, no fake readable text, no watermark, no UI, no flickering color, no warped hands, no extra fingers, no face morphing, no unstable identity.

global_camera_enhancers.prompt_en: Modern creator camera simulation, natural 180-degree shutter motion blur, native ISO-style clean shadows, controlled highlight rolloff, realistic autofocus micro-recovery, subtle handheld micro-jitter, optical stabilization, gentle lens breathing, mild compression texture, realistic skin detail, stable white balance, no digital zoom, no artificial sharpening halos.

luts.name: Premium UGC Warm
luts.look_goal: Warm premium UGC that still feels shot by a real creator, not a polished studio commercial.
luts.color_grade_prompt_en: Premium UGC Warm LUT: warm beige midtones, soft champagne highlights, creamy but realistic skin tones, gentle brown shadows, clean whites, mild contrast, cozy tungsten practicals, natural indoor exposure, polished lifestyle commercial warmth without orange oversaturation.

film_grain.halation: subtle warm halation around lamps and window highlights
film_grain.bloom: very soft highlight bloom only on practical lights

luts.camera_enhancers_prompt_en: Creator camera look, realistic handheld push-in, optical stabilization, 180-degree shutter blur, native ISO clean shadows, soft highlight rolloff, gentle autofocus breathing, realistic phone-camera compression texture, natural skin pores.
luts.copy_paste_suffix_en: COLOR GRADE / LUT STYLE: Premium UGC Warm LUT, warm beige midtones, soft champagne highlights, creamy realistic skin tones, gentle brown shadows, clean whites, mild contrast, cozy tungsten practicals, natural indoor exposure. Add 200T fine film grain at low-medium intensity, subtle warm halation around lamps, very soft bloom on practical highlights. Camera enhancers: realistic creator camera, optical stabilization, 180-degree shutter motion blur, native ISO clean shadows, soft highlight rolloff, gentle autofocus breathing, mild phone-camera compression texture. No HDR look, no orange oversaturation, no waxy skin.
